Yahan Principal ke liye ek formal leave application ka draft hai. Aap bracket `[ ]` mein di gayi jagah par apni details bharein.

***

**To,**
The Principal,
[School/College Name],
[City/Location]

**Subject:** Application for leave on medical/personal grounds.

**Respected Sir/Madam,**

With due respect, I am [Your Name], a student of Class [Your Class] and Section [Your Section], bearing Roll No. [Your Roll Number].

I am writing to inform you that there is a close family function at my house. Therefore, I will not be able to attend classes from **[Start Date]** to **[End Date]** (3 days).

I kindly request you to grant me leave for these three days. I shall be obliged.

**Yours obediently,**

[Your Name]
Class: [Your Class]
Roll No.: [Your Roll Number]
Date: [Current Date]

***

**Hindi Version (Agar Hindi medium school hai):**

**श्रीमान प्रधानाचार्य महोदय,**
[School/College Name],
[City/Location]

**विषय:** छुट्टी के लिए आवेदन पत्र।

**महोदय,**

सविनय निवेदन है कि मैं [Your Name], कक्षा [Your Class] का छात्र/छात्रा हूँ। मेरे घर में एक धार्मिक/पारिवारिक कार्यक्रम है, जिसके कारण मैं [Start Date] से [End Date] तक (कुल 3 दिन) स्कूल/कॉलेज में उपस्थित नहीं हो पाऊंगा/पाऊंगी।

अतः आपसे अनुरोध है कि मुझे इन तीन दिनों की छुट्टी दे दी जाए।

**धन्यवाद।**

**भवदीय,**
[Your Name]
कक्षा: [Your Class]
पंजीयन क्रमांक: [Your Roll Number]
दिनांक: [Current Date]
